options.name: ansible_collection_auth_token
options.description: The token key to use for authentication.

options.name: ansible_collection_auth_url
options.description: The URL to receive a session token from, e.g. used with Automation Hub.

options.name: ansible_collection_requirements
options.description: Contents of requirement yaml file to sync from URL

options.name: arch
options.description: Architecture of content in the repository Set to C(noarch) to disable the architecture restriction again.

options.name: auto_enabled
options.description: repositories will be automatically enabled on a registered host subscribed to this product

options.name: ca_path
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_CA_PATH) will be used instead.

options.name: checksum_type
options.description: Checksum of the repository

options.name: content_type
options.description: The content type of the repository

options.name: deb_architectures
options.description: comma separated list of architectures to be synced from deb-archive only available for I(content_type=deb)

options.name: deb_components
options.description: comma separated list of repo components to be synced from deb-archive only available for I(content_type=deb)

options.name: deb_errata_url
options.description: URL to sync Debian or Ubuntu errata information from only available on Orcharhino only available for I(content_type=deb)

options.name: deb_releases
options.description: comma separated list of releases to be synced from deb-archive only available for I(content_type=deb)

options.name: depth
options.description: An option to specify how many ostree commits to traverse.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the repository

options.name: docker_tags_whitelist
options.description: list of tags to sync for Container Image repository only available for I(content_type=docker) Deprecated since Katello 4.4

options.name: docker_upstream_name
options.description: name of the upstream docker repository only available for I(content_type=docker)

options.name: download_concurrency
options.description: download concurrency for sync from upstream as the API does not return this value, this will break idempotence for this module

options.name: download_policy
options.description: The download policy for sync from upstream. The download policy C(background) is deprecated and not available since Katello 4.3.

options.name: exclude_refs
options.description: List of tags to exclude during an ostree sync. The wildcards C(*), C(?) are recognized. C(exclude_refs) is evaluated after C(include_refs).

options.name: exclude_tags
options.description: List of tags to exclude when syncing a container image repository.

options.name: excludes
options.description: Python packages to exclude from the upstream URL. You may also specify versions, for example: C(django~=2.0).

options.name: gpg_key
options.description: Repository GPG key

options.name: http_proxy
options.description: Name of the http proxy to use for content synching Should be combined with I(http_proxy_policy='use_selected_http_proxy')

options.name: http_proxy_policy
options.description: Which proxy to use for content synching

options.name: ignorable_content
options.description: List of content units to ignore while syncing a yum repository. Must be subset of rpm,drpm,srpm,distribution,erratum.

options.name: ignore_global_proxy
options.description: Whether content sync should use or ignore the global http proxy setting This is deprecated with Katello 3.13 It has been superseeded by I(http_proxy_policy)

options.name: include_refs
options.description: List of refs to include during an ostree sync. The wildcards C(*), C(?) are recognized.

options.name: include_tags
options.description: List of tags to sync for a container image repository.

options.name: includes
options.description: Python packages to include from the upstream URL, You may also specify versions, for example: C(django~=2.0). Leave empty to include every package.

options.name: keep_latest_packages
options.description: The amount of latest versions of a package to keep on sync, includes pre-releases if synced. Defaults to keep all versions.

options.name: label
options.description: label of the repository

options.name: metadata_expire
options.description: Set the metadata expiration time (in seconds) for a yum repository.

options.name: mirror_on_sync
options.description: toggle "mirror on sync" where the state of the repository mirrors that of the upstream repository at sync time This is deprecated with Katello 4.3 It has been superseeded by I(mirroring_policy=mirror_content_only)

options.name: mirroring_policy
options.description: Policy to set for mirroring content Supported since Katello 4.3

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the repository

options.name: oauth1_consumer_key
options.description: OAuth1 consumer key for accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_OAUTH1_CONSUMER_KEY) will be used instead.

options.name: oauth1_consumer_secret
options.description: OAuth1 consumer secret for accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_OAUTH1_CONSUMER_SECRET) will be used instead.

options.name: organization
options.description: Organization that the entity is in

options.name: os_versions
options.description: Identifies whether the repository should be disabled on a client with a non-matching OS version. A maximum of one OS version can be selected. Set to C([]) to disable filtering again.

options.name: package_types
options.description: Package types to sync for Python content, separated by comma. FIXME Leave empty to get every package type.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the user accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: product
options.description: Product to which the repository lives in

options.name: retain_package_versions_count
options.description: The maximum number of versions of each package to keep.

options.name: server_url
options.description: URL of the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_SERVER_URL) will be used instead.

options.name: ssl_ca_cert
options.description: Repository SSL CA certificate

options.name: ssl_client_cert
options.description: Repository SSL client certificate

options.name: ssl_client_key
options.description: Repository SSL client private key

options.name: state
options.description: State of the entity C(present_with_defaults) will ensure the entity exists, but won't update existing ones

options.name: unprotected
options.description: publish the repository via HTTP

options.name: upstream_authentication_token
options.description: Upstream authentication token string for yum repositories.

options.name: upstream_password
options.description: Password to access upstream repository. When this parameter is set, the module will not be idempotent.

options.name: upstream_username
options.description: username to access upstream repository

options.name: url
options.description: Repository URL to sync from

options.name: use_gssapi
options.description: Use GSSAPI to perform the authentication, typically this is for Kerberos or Kerberos through Negotiate authentication. Requires the Python library L(requests-gssapi,https://github.com/pythongssapi/requests-gssapi) to be installed. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_USE_GSSAPI) will be used instead.

options.name: username
options.description: Username accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to verify the TLS certificates of the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.

options.name: verify_ssl_on_sync
options.description: verify the upstream certifcates are signed by a trusted CA
